reason: The esp32c6-zenoh profile produces no linkable image at the locked Core e065a7b: the application calls runCarrierNetworkProbe and emitAgentExchange, which only the MQTT transport defines, so the build fails before an artifact exists. The pinned zenoh-pico component does compile; see esp32c6-zenoh-zenoh-pico-compile.json. Generalizing the application carrier seam for a second transport is tracked by the embedded Zenoh implementation issue.
